highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews the Skia m154 engine update and corrects HarfBuzzSharp enum compatibility.
highlights_body: The preview moves the bundled renderer to the m154 line. HarfBuzzSharp follows current upstream enum names and removes aggregate mask constants that should not be passed as independent options.

breaking.title: UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 renamed to CCC132
breaking.body: The misspelled HarfBuzz enum member is corrected to `CCC132`; its numeric value remains 132. Update source code that references `CCC133` and rebuild.

breaking.title: Aggregate HarfBuzz flag masks are unavailable
breaking.body: `GlyphFlags.Defined` is removed, and aggregate `Defined` members are not exposed for buffer-related flag enums. Combine the concrete flags your code requires instead of using an aggregate mask.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer onto the Skia m154 line for preview consumers.

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Preview 1 introduces the Skia m154 engine update and the accompanying HarfBuzzSharp compatibility corrections.

v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews the Skia m154 engine update.
v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.body: It updates the bundled renderer for the new release line and includes HarfBuzzSharp compatibility corrections.
